sign_in.title: Sign in to Wambito
sign_in.lead: No passwords: we'll email you a code.
sign_in.first_time: First time? Sign in with your email; you can use your fingerprint afterwards.

sign_in.resent: We sent you a new code.

verify.confirm_lead: Tap Continue to sign in to Wambito with this email.
verify.app_lead: Open Wambito on your phone to sign in with this email, or carry on here on the web.

assistants.title: Connect your assistant
assistants.lead: Talk to Wambito from Claude or ChatGPT: log spending and ask how you're doing without opening the app.

setup.lead: It is the only way back to your data if you lose every device and passkey. Nobody can recover it for you, not even Wambito.

unlock.error_wrong_recovery_key: That key does not open this account. Try the one you saved when you created it.
